caption:
does gym sweat cause back acne?

Probably not on its own.

Where does yours show up: back, chest or shoulders? One word below.

In a small randomized trial, active men worked up a sweat five days a week for two weeks. One group didn't exercise, one showered within an hour, and one waited at least four hours. At the end, chest and back acne wasn't significantly different between the groups. It was a tiny study (23 men) and a short one, so treat it as a hint, not the final word.

What doctors look at instead: friction, pressure, heat and covered skin. Tight straps, a damp shirt and gear rubbing on hot skin can set off bumps in the spots they press.

Try this for two weeks: loose, dry clothes at the gym, and change out of a wet shirt soon after.

Send this to your gym buddy who blames his sweat.

General education only. If your acne is painful, scarring or not improving, see a doctor in person.
